current_answer: FPF’s Q4 Zcash retroactive grant accepts proposals for completed, publicly verifiable work through 13 November 2026 at 20:00 UTC. Individuals and companies can apply, but future work does not qualify. Requests have no fixed cap; any approved award is paid in ZEC after voting and checks.

catalogue_card.question: Finished Zcash work? A retroactive grant closes 13 November.
catalogue_card.text: Individuals and companies can propose completed, publicly verifiable work. File on GitHub and mirror it in the forum; without the backlink, FPF says it will not reach the vote. Requests are in USD, but any award is paid in ZEC.

summary: Q4 submission deadline: 13 November 2026, 20:00 UTC; this round does not fund future or unfinished work.
FPF lists no fixed request cap. Requests above USD 50,000 require KYC before disbursement, and coinholder voting and keyholder checks control any award.
A GitHub proposal, separate forum thread and backlink are required for vote listing. NLnet’s form still shows 3 November, 12:00 CET.
